title: [main] Add setup option to restore Sales and Purchase Order quantities when posting returns
summary: Added optional settings to control whether credit memo and invoice-correction operations restore quantities on originating sales and purchase orders, with both settings enabled by default to maintain current behavior.
key_points: New setup fields added to Sales & Receivables Setup and Purchases & Payables Setup tables to control quantity restoration on corrective operations
When enabled, existing quantity-restoration behavior is preserved; when disabled, quantities remain unchanged on originating orders
Restoration-specific confirmations and warnings display only when the setting is enabled
Prepayment deduction reversals proceed regardless of settings to maintain order consistency
All existing and new companies default to enabled settings, and comprehensive test coverage includes both enabled and disabled scenarios
quote: Adds settings to control whether existing credit-memo and invoice-correction flows restore quantities on originating sales and purchase orders
